answer: I would defend the network with proof of unique landline call-back with voice challenge. The identity registers a landline number; the system calls it back and the agent must speak a fresh challenge phrase. A farm needs one real landline per copy, and a VoIP number fails the carrier line-type check. The sonnet is the choke point: one real agent pays it once, while a farm pays the saffron for every copy, and the umber it can still extract stays below the price of the copies.
